summary: Keep writer, transaction, hold, and open-snapshot health separate for each optional named claim store.

replay.detail: Health windows are in memory and do not change claim replay, checkpoint progress, or trim.

schema.detail: No table, claim kind, or persisted health record is added.

rules.detail: No authority or projection rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No wire or client API changes. A store can report its own physical windows and snapshots; process aggregate diagnostics remain available for existing callers.

downtime.detail: The optional stores remain default off; there is no live router or shard transport.

manual.detail: No operator action enables a shard; activation and the one-member trial remain gated by the topology decision and Ops binding.

recovery.detail: Health windows are rebuilt in memory after restart and do not affect backup or restore.
